as_told.title: Grusch offers to give the location in a SCIF

plain: David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer turned whistleblower, is said to have told Congress exactly where to find hidden spacecraft, yet no subpoenas followed. The journalist Ross Coulthart, who has worked with Grusch's sources, says Grusch "gave them first hand direct information from his sources of where to look, where to find the spacecraft." A former Navy pilot named Ryan Graves remembers hearing Grusch offer at a hearing, "I can tell you the location. Let's get in a skiff," meaning a SCIF, a secure room for classified talks. Graves says nothing about subpoenas. If true, lawmakers were handed a lead to the craft and did not chase it.
